verdicts.reason: A keeps a clean top-to-bottom order with brand, headline, phone-in-circle and CTA, but the badges now sit below the CTA, which breaks hierarchy and grouping. There is also a big dead gap under the headline, the subcopy is tiny, and the left-aligned headline clashes with the centred badges. B is broken: the green circle has shrunk and drifted to the phone's lower-left corner, the 'Mint is back' line runs almost edge to edge, the badges and CTA are staggered left and right at random, the CTA hugs the right edge, and the bottom sixth of the canvas is empty.
